evidence.scope: Conditional dry-contact design requirements; no measured artificial-firn performance

contact_material.identity: Unfilled polyetherimide candidate; literature GP-PEI exact grade not confirmed to equal ULTEM1000
contact_material.density_source: S2 manufacturer typical value, not a50C certificate
contact_material.note: Cylindrical volume proxy; shape factor is allowance, not a manufactured geometry. Prices hypothetical; added material, no displacement credit.

run_in.note: Uncalibrated phenomenological coverage state, load-weighted, not an area or probability. Renewal fraction resets conditioned load paths, not particle mass replacement. Neither paper COF nor wear factor assigned to a candidate.

conditioning.note: Lower-bound time/energy diagnostic with20m width over2000m2. Does not include maneuvers, shear of bed, coverage gaps, new exposures or capital cost. No conditioning equipment adopted.

wear.note: Constant-pressure local-depth screen h=k p n L; cap k unknown; reported UHMWPE pin k belongs to ski-side material, never assigned to PEI counterface. Geometry change, peeling, fatigue, edge scratches not predicted.

contact.note: Effective Hertz modulus is assumed pairing value. Ratios3 are conservative screening choices, not validated layered-contact accuracy or strength criteria.

manufacturing.note: Equivalent placement count; no demonstrated individual micro-insert process. A continuous multi-material process would need separate proof.

budget.note: Inherited pretax hypothetical allowance, not quote. Cap replacement rates are additional to2percent purchase replacement. No environmental emission allowance. Equipment capJPY200M tax-inclusive remains separate.

rocking.note: Travel bound for one finite rotation of a centre-fixed contact. Not a free rolling or bearing solution.
